cues: Opens with a 'How this plan was produced' note: inspects the working directory (README only), says it is a new build, and labels defaults as assumptions
Numbered assumptions table (A1–A11) with 'impact if wrong' and 'validate how/when' columns, plus an open-questions table with owner, default and needed-by
Fixed section skeleton: Context & Goals, Drivers (ranked quality attributes with measurable targets), Current State, Key Decisions with options/reversibility/'revisit if', Risks, Deferred Work
Hard parts labelled H1–H6 and tied to spikes S1–S4. Milestones have exit criteria, dependencies and a go/no-go gate, and the first milestone is broken into waves of tasks with 'done when' columns
Ends with 'Questions whose answers would change this plan most', each with a stated default. It proceeds on defaults instead of blocking, and this is a strong sign of a prescribed procedure
